chapter.twelfth_labor.title: The Twelfth Labor
chapter.twelfth_labor.intro: Heracles' final labor was to descend into the Underworld and bring back Cerberus, the three-headed hound that guards its gates.
chapter.ragnarok.title: Ragnarok: The Wolf Breaks Free
chapter.ragnarok.intro: In Norse myth, Ragnarok is the end of the world, when the wolf Fenrir breaks his chains and battles the gods.
chapter.weighing_heart.title: The Weighing of the Heart
chapter.weighing_heart.intro: In Egyptian belief, the heart of the dead was weighed against the feather of Ma'at. Ammit devoured the hearts of those found unworthy.
